svg.title: Changing only the learning rate changes the path
svg.desc: Starting at u=0 for J=(u-3)^2: lr0.05 losses are9,7.29,5.9049,4.782969; lr0.25 losses9,2.25,0.5625,0.140625; lr1.1 losses9,12.96,18.6624,26.873856. Each series contains the initial state and three updates.
